submission.justification: T3 has the best unirradiated resolution (6 um) but fails the radiation requirement (82% efficiency at 2e16 vs >=97% needed). Of the two remaining options, T1 has better resolution than T2 (9 vs 14 um at 150 um) and 98.5% efficiency, which meets the requirement. The 100 um thickness is a judgment call. The documents contain no thickness scan, and no simulation tool was available. I chose a thinner sensor because it should limit charge spread and trapping after irradiation. Efficiency and resolution at 100 um are not verified and should be checked with a simulation or test beam.

requirements.evidence: T1 gives 9 um at 150 um, unirradiated. This is the best of the radiation-qualified options. T3 is better at 6 um but is excluded.
T1 has 98.5% hit efficiency after 2e16 neq/cm^2, against a requirement of >=97%. This was measured at a different thickness than the one recommended.
100 um is within the allowed range. It is not optimized, because no thickness scan data exist.
